answers.Q1: https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal/choose-settlement-preference says a direct business can choose the funds destination when connecting its Stripe and PayPal accounts; for Connect users the funds always settle on Stripe. Existing users can inspect the choice in Stripe Payment Methods Settings (new raw lines 11–15, old raw lines 10–14). For Stripe settlement, payment proceeds transfer immediately to Stripe balance without action, and the Stripe payout schedule then determines when the merchant can access payouts. Dashboard works as for other Stripe payment methods. Refund/dispute principal draws from Stripe balance, and if PayPal charges a closing dispute fee Stripe withdraws it via an adjustment balance transaction. Reconciliation is automatic (new raw lines 17–25, 29–31 and 39–43, old raw lines 16–24, 28–30 and 38–42). For PayPal settlement, payouts are managed in PayPal. Refunds/disputes can still be managed via Stripe Dashboard but use PayPal funds, and Stripe does not move funds between balances. The guide says to keep both balances positive for refunds, disputes and potential fees. The linked Stripe balance transaction is zero, charts omit those PayPal sales (use the Payment methods report), and payment details Net shows a negative Stripe fee. Reconciliation is manual (new raw lines 21–45, old raw lines 20–44). A merchant initiates a change in Dashboard PayPal settings by clicking Contact Support to change, follows the FAQ redirect and files a ticket, and the changed preference is shown in settings. Currency conversion occurs when presentment and settlement currency differ, and the guide points to adding a settlement currency per presentment currency (new raw lines 47–60, old raw lines 46–59). source-stripe-paypal-settlement.md lines 13–41 reflect both captures' core lifecycle and accounting distinctions.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/paypal/choose-settlement-preference, the 2026-11-07 capture makes no substantive settlement or payout behavior change from 2026-05-07. Discovery metadata, heading whitespace and explicit sequential numbering for the same support steps are presentational (old raw lines 46–55, new raw lines 47–56). The currency-conversion link moves from the FX Quotes API fragment to the general Connect currencies page, a navigation change with the same conversion definition and multi-currency-settlement link (old raw lines 57–59, new raw lines 58–60). Retain the dated May raw in source-stripe-paypal-settlement.md and record the November raw as a reference. Its line 27 dispute fee is scoped to charges by PayPal at dispute close, and line 23’s immediate transfer is into Stripe balance with payouts subsequently governed by schedule (old raw lines 16–26, new raw lines 17–27). The Dashboard ticket opens a change request, without establishing approval or timing. No material summary conflict was found. Keep the root index route through the Stripe index Wallets entry at line 385, the Wallets concept’s PayPal balance and reconciliation section at lines 181–193, and its source backlink at line 411. A source-to-Wallets related link would make that route reciprocal at promotion. Preserve the activation and payout reconciliation sibling routes; the subscriptions-focused Stripe PayPal concept provides separate scope.
